headline: Solstice Advanced Materials Stock Gains 3% Following Q3 Beat
summary: Solstice Advanced Materials shares gained 3% after the company beat third-quarter financial estimates.
why: Advanced materials companies supply high-tech and industrial sectors, making their earnings reports important indicators for specialized manufacturing demand.

impacts.name: Solstice Advanced Materials
impacts.why: Exceeding quarterly estimates directly drives positive investor sentiment and share price appreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected quarterly financial results directly drove investor demand and a 3% share price increase.
